name: Soredemo Tsuma o Ai Shiteru
original_name: それでも妻を愛してる
source:
Honda, the protagonist, is an ordinary businessman who works for a trading company as chief of the sales department.

He is married to Nanami. He used to be her superior and soon developed a relationship which ended up in marriage. They live a happy life and support each other. However, Honda was a late bloomer and is inexperienced with women. Lately he is filled with uneasiness, asking himself if he is worthy of his wife, if she is satisfied with him in many ways...

Their third wedding anniversary is coming soon, so there may be no better chance to shake off the uneasiness Honda feels. However, the hands of the devil are reaching out to his lovely wife Nanami. Honda will have to fight the demons that approach his wife or...
translation:
主人公本田是一名普通上班族，在贸易公司担任销售部部长。

他与七海结为夫妻。过去，他曾是七海的上司，两人很快发展出恋情，最后步入婚姻。他们过着幸福生活，彼此扶持。然而，本田开窍较晚，缺乏与女性相处的经验。近来，他总被不安笼罩，反复问自己是否配得上妻子、能否在各方面令她满足……

两人的结婚三周年纪念日即将到来，这或许是驱散本田不安的最好机会。然而，恶魔之手正伸向他深爱的妻子七海。本田必须与接近妻子的恶魔战斗，否则……
